setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A repeat offender keeps exploiting others' goodwill despite warnings and opportunities to stop.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Unverified rumors are excluded from the decision.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The offender loses access to vulnerable duties.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Neighbors create safe ways to report further problems.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The offender refuses the conditions and faces exclusion.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They comply temporarily but trust is restored only through sustained action.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The community prioritizes safety over a comforting ending.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Villagers acknowledge that not everyone chooses to improve.
